metadata.title: Casson invariant of knots defined by random braids
metadata.abstract: We investigate the expectation $E(v_2)$ of the Casson invariant $v_2$ for knots represented by two similar types of braids, the rosette $s$-braids which are products of $k$ factors $\prod_{1\leq 2i\leq s}\sigma_{2i}^{\pm 1}\prod_{1\leq 2i+\leq s}\sigma_{2i+1}^{\pm 1}$ and the quasitoric $s$-braids which are products of $k$ factors $\sigma_{1}^{\pm 1}\sigma_{2}^{\pm 1}...\sigma_{s-1}^{\pm 1}$. If $k$ is of the form $ns+1$, $\dfrac{E(v_2)}{c}\sim \dfrac{s+1}{24}$ where $c$ is the number of crossing points of braid; if $k$ is of the form $ns-1$, $\dfrac{E(v_2)}{c}\sim \dfrac{5-s}{24}$.\\ If we go through all $3$-braids, regardless of the shape of their diagram, we get $\dfrac{E(v_2)}{c}\sim \dfrac{1}{8}$. \\ For knots with a checkerboard diagram, $\dfrac{E(v_2)}{c}\sim \dfrac{1}{16}$.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 随机辫结Casson不变量的期望渐近
analysis.workSummary: 作者研究随机符号rosette及quasitoric s辫表示的结Casson不变量v₂期望，按k=ns+1及ns−1得到E(v₂)/交叉数分别趋(s+1)/24和(5−s)/24；另对全体3辫及checkerboard图得到1/8及1/16的对应渐近。
techniques: 按辫因子数的期望渐近
analysis.breakthrough: 区分不同辫结构及剩余类导致的平均不变量行为。
analysis.limitations: 这是给定随机模型的期望，不是逐结点态值或通用结分布；渐近参数、符号概率及闭包为结条件需正文确认。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
